text:
Kai (Partnerships): Quick thread to tidy up the preflight checklist for marketplace listing onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Aim: a single, minimal packaging bundle that passes vendor preflight and lets us iterate on pricing/upsells. Gaps I'm tracking: 1) canonical SKU names + cloud mapping, 2) publisher IDs + admin grants, 3) EULA/export residency signoff, 4) final assets (logos/screenshots) and permission emails. Plan: staging push next Thu.

Rina (Marketplace Ops): Staging steps I need from Partnerships/Product: list of emails for marketplace-admin for each staging tenant, artifact types (AMI / VHD / container tar), and a pricebook CSV. I can create staging publisher IDs if you want: aws-stg-555, gcp-stg-556, azure-stg-557. Reminder: each cloud requires signed manifest + checksum for image artifacts. Example: ```sha256sum redwood-ami-2026-03-20.img```

Omar (Legal): Upload the draft EULA and the telemetry/data flow summary so I can check for PII/retention/export flags. Two immediate legal checks: 1) if logs include org_id/user_id we need a DPA clause and retention table by region; 2) export control: are any model weights or tooling flagged under restrictions? If yes, we must region-gate listings and add explicit language. Also: trials may need separate trial T&Cs depending on cloud billing behavior.

Zoe (Product): Proposed canonical SKUs (single source of truth): redwood-core-sub, redwood-dedicated-addon, redwood-private-addon. Mapping file will map these to cloud-specific SKUs and meter names, e.g., AWS: redwood-core-sub -> SKU_AWS_001, meter: redwood.inference.hour. Trials: default 14d auto-apply to core-sub only. I'll drop SKU mapping JSON and sample pricebook CSV into the artifacts bucket by EOD today.

Ben (Cloud Infra): For images: recommend container artifact for cross-cloud compatibility (ECR/GCR/ACR). But AWS Marketplace still wants an AMI for image-based listings. Suggest we publish both: container for GCP/Azure, AMI for AWS. I'll produce signed manifests and checksums. Also callout: for AMIs list supported instance types (g4dn.xlarge, g5.xlarge) and driver minimums in the packaging README.

ArtifactoryBot: Uploaded artifacts -> https://internal.redwood/artifacts/1799998888. Contains: placeholder logos, packaging README, SKU-mapping-draft.json, pricebook-template.csv, and PR template for legal.

Rina (Marketplace Ops): Note on pricing metadata: some markets require separate region-level pricing entries. If we plan EU-only pricing or trial-limited offers, include a region column in the pricebook. Also include whether the SKU is metered hourly, monthly subscription, or one-time.

Omar (Legal): Quick question for Product: will telemetry sent back to our hosted analytics include IP addresses or user identifiers? If yes, we need to include opt-out details and retention windows in the listing (and possibly the DPA).

Zoe (Product): Telemetry plan: anonymized usage metrics (counts, latency histograms) by org_id only (no user-level IDs). We said we'd hash org_id; but if Legal needs stronger guarantees we can add salt and rotation. No IP addresses planned to be shipped in telemetry.

Omar (Legal): Hashing org_id is okay if documented; please provide the hashing approach (salt, rotation) and the fields included. I will draft the retention table and DPA language at that point.

Kai (Partnerships): Action list (owners):
- Ben: produce signed manifests + checksums for AMI/container variants and list supported instance types by Tue COB (owner: Ben)
- Zoe: drop SKU-mapping JSON + pricebook CSV into artifacts by EOD today (owner: Zoe)
- Rina: create staging publisher IDs and add marketplace-admins (Kai + Zoe + Omar) by Mon EOD (owner: Rina)
- Omar: review EULA + telemetry summary and post flags by Wed EOD (owner: Omar)
- Marketing (cc @Cassandra): provide final logos (SVG light/dark), 600x400 hero, and 1:1 badge by Wed COB (owner: Marketing)

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the assignment. If anyone needs a 10m sync tomorrow morning, say so and I'll book. Also flag any partner marketing permissions if you plan to show vendor co-branding in the listing. Thanks! :rocket:
